description: Enhance the header with global progress indicator, notification bell with due items count, quick-start study button, and keyboard shortcut hints in UI. Also create a local profile system that works without Supabase.
steps: Refactor src/shared/components/layout/header.tsx: (a) Replace the empty left-side div with a compact global readiness progress bar (thin horizontal bar showing overall readiness % with tooltip). (b) Add a notification bell icon with badge count showing total due items (flashcards due + review items due). Clicking it opens a dropdown with notification items and links to their pages. (c) Add a prominent 'Start Session' CTA button (gold background, compact) that links to /questions. (d) Keep the existing search trigger and theme toggle on the right side.

Create src/shared/components/layout/notification-dropdown.tsx - a dropdown panel triggered by the bell icon. Shows up to 5 recent notification items (flashcards due, streak warning, review items). Each item is clickable linking to the relevant page. Reuse logic from src/features/notifications/components/notification-badges.tsx but in a dropdown format.

Create src/shared/lib/local-profile.ts - a localStorage-based profile system. Store and retrieve: displayName, level (I/II/III), examDate, studyHoursPerDay, targetScore. Provide getLocalProfile() and saveLocalProfile() functions. Default values: displayName='CFA Student', level='I'.

Refactor src/app/(protected)/profile/page.tsx to use the local profile system when Supabase is not configured. Render a form with fields: Display Name, CFA Level (I/II/III dropdown), Exam Date (date input), Study Hours/Day (number), Target Score (number). Save to localStorage via the local-profile utility. Remove the 'Supabase not configured' dead-end message.

Update src/features/dashboard/components/dashboard-content.tsx to read displayName and level from the local profile system (getLocalProfile()) instead of relying solely on server-side Supabase user data. The server page src/app/(protected)/dashboard/page.tsx should still pass defaults, but the client component should prefer localStorage values.

Add visible keyboard shortcut hints: In the sidebar footer area (above Settings link), add a small '? Shortcuts' link that triggers the existing KeyboardShortcutsModal. Format: small text with a kbd-styled '?' icon.
acceptance_criteria: Header shows a compact readiness progress bar on the left side
Notification bell with badge count appears in header, dropdown shows due items
Start Session button is visible in the header and links to /questions
Profile page works fully without Supabase - form saves to localStorage
Dashboard reads displayName/level from localStorage profile
Keyboard shortcuts link visible in sidebar footer opens the shortcuts modal
